description: This file defines API routes for managing courses in an LMS backend using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, and retrieving course details, with integration to MongoDB for data persistence, and handles serialization and error handling.

methods.name: CourseOut _serialize_course(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Serializes MongoDB course document into CourseOut model.

methods.name: list_courses( category: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by category"), published: Optional[bool] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by published flag"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list courses with optional filters.

methods.name: create_course( payload: CourseCreate, user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new course.

methods.name: get_course(course_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a course by its ID.

ctags.signature: ( category: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by category"), published: Optional[bool] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by published flag"), )
